connector.name: SignalEDI
connector.registryDescription: EDI parse, validate, send, inspect, and QuickBooks tools for MCP clients.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the signaledi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SIGNALEDI_API_KEY
env.description: Workspace API key with the platform scope. Optional for demo mode; create one at https://signaledi.com/console/keys for send, transactions, and QuickBooks tools.

env.name: SIGNALEDI_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://signaledi.com; point at a preview deployment or custom domain when needed.
